draft.title: Equality in the justice system
card: Equality means people are treated the same by the justice system, with the same rules and the same chance to take part.
Treating everyone exactly the same can sometimes leave a person at a disadvantage. For example, a person who does not speak English well may not follow a hearing.
Where that would happen, measures are taken to correct it. This helps each person take part on a similar footing.
An interpreter for a witness is one such measure. It does not favour the witness. It removes a barrier that others do not face.
draft.remember: Equality is the same treatment, adjusted where sameness would disadvantage someone.

a.q: Why might a court sometimes treat people differently to achieve equality?
opts: Identical treatment could leave some people disadvantaged
Some people should receive a better outcome than others
Rules should apply only to people who can follow them
Courts must treat each party differently in every case
a.why: Measures are used where the same treatment would disadvantage a person, so that they can take part on a similar footing. The second option is tempting, but the aim is to correct a barrier, not to favour someone.
a.clue: Think about what sameness can do to a person who faces a barrier.

b.q: Tomas, a witness, is deaf and cannot follow questions in court. The court provides an Auslan interpreter. What does this show?
opts: A measure to correct a disadvantage sameness would cause
Unfair treatment, as other witnesses receive no interpreter
A change to the verdict so that Tomas is favoured
The court treating every witness in exactly the same way
b.why: Without the interpreter, identical treatment would leave Tomas unable to take part. The interpreter removes that barrier. It is not unfair to others, as it does not favour his evidence.
b.clue: Ask what Tomas could not do if he were treated exactly like the other witnesses.

a.best: Identical treatment could leave some people disadvantaged

b.best: A measure to correct a disadvantage sameness would cause
